source_observation: consumeQwenStream emits text/reasoning immediately while the upstream stream is still open.
If the same attempt later ends with WAF_CAPTCHA_CHALLENGE or the recognized empty/dead-thread error, runTurn discards only the upstream route and transparently retries on another eligible account.
No rollback/reset event retracts text/reasoning already emitted by the failed attempt.
The local chat history records only the successful retry result because the failed consumeQwenStream promise never returns a result to runTurn.
risk: The caller can observe a transcript that is not the transcript retained by the agent for the next model turn.
Transparent account failover can splice two different provider attempts into one visible assistant stream.
A downstream coding client that treats emitted text/reasoning as committed output cannot reconcile it from the saved local history after restart/failover.
candidate_contract: Track whether the current upstream attempt emitted any externally visible text/reasoning before a recoverable stream error.
Transparent retry is allowed only while the failed attempt emitted nothing externally visible.
If output already escaped, fail closed instead of automatically appending a replacement-account stream, unless a future protocol adds an explicit reset/replace event that every caller understands.
Do not change account cooldown/failover policy for failures that happen before external output.
required_regression: First account emits a text delta and then WAF_CAPTCHA_CHALLENGE; second account is available. Assert that the implementation does not emit text from both attempts as one successful turn. Existing zero-output CAPTCHA recovery must remain green.
